title: Update on CPIB Investigation into Seatrium
what_it_is: Update on CPIB Investigation into Seatrium

sections.label: Seatrium and Sembcorp Marine merger
sections.summary: Seatrium Limited was formerly Sembcorp Marine Limited, which merged with Keppel Offshore and Marine in February 2023, and investigations are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Seatrium Limited was previously known as Sembcorp Marine Limited, which merged with Keppel Offshore and Marine Limited (KOM) in February 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As investigations are ongoing, it is not appropriate to provide further details at this juncture.

sections.label: Singapore zero-tolerance corruption policy
sections.summary: There is no change in Singapore's zero-tolerance policy on corruption and commitment to uphold the rule of law.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Suffice to say, there is no change in Singapore's zero-tolerance policy on corruption and our commitment to uphold the rule of law.

sections.label: Temasek capital injection decision
sections.summary: Based on available facts and disclosures at that time, Temasek made an independent, commercial decision to inject capital into the company.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Based on the available facts and disclosures at that time, Temasek made an independent, commercial decision to inject capital into the company.

sections.label: Corruption tolerance and CPIB bounties
sections.summary: Singapore has zero tolerance towards corruption, and CPIB says there is no shortage of people providing information or whistleblowing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Singapore's approach is to have zero tolerance towards corruption.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: With regard to the second question of whether CPIB should offer bounties or rewards for information that lead to conviction, first, I understand from CPIB that, actually, there is no shortage of people coming forward to provide information or whistleblowing.

sections.label: Government zero tolerance on corruption
sections.summary: MOF and the Government as a whole have a well-known position of zero tolerance on corruption.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: MOF and the Government, as a whole, it is well-known that our position is that we have to have zero tolerance on corruption.

sections.label: Temasek engagement with portfolio companies
sections.summary: Temasek, as mentioned publicly before, does regular engagements with their portfolio companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: With respect to Temasek, I think as they had mentioned before publicly, they do regular engagements with their portfolio companies.
